title: 10/10 Experience
text: Daniel was awesome, I highly recommend booking with him. We did a 2-hour sunset sail and the experience was perfect.
author: ryanbZ806HL

title: Fantastic afternoon!
text: Daniel was our captain and he was fantastic! He supplied music, snacks, and kept the cava flowing! This was a perfect opportunity to unwind and chat with other travelers
author: Kimberly_A

title: What an experience
text:
It was a lovely experience from the booking to the actual cruise.  Edu was the tour guide and was exceptionally precise and detailed, the drinks was more than enough, the olives tasted so natural and was said to be known as “yeye”, I found it in the market and enjoyed it more. The timing of the sunset was so accurate and by then the drinks have started kicking in.

This was my best experience so far
In Spain.. Glad I followed my instincts to go on this experience.
author: akanoelu

title: Fun
text: It was the most picturesque and relaxing ride ever, watching the sunset in the arms of my love.
author: 971sylviao

title: This excursion was so...
text: This excursion was so fun! The boat guides were friendly, funny, and very accommodating! We met great people during out tour and end up hitting the town with them for and amazing night in Barcelona!
author: Michelle_P

title: Barcelona skyline and sundowner
text:
A brilliant two hour trip with only six passengers. 
Skipper Miguel and his mate were so nice, took time to describe the coastline and they were both very friendly., even allowed us to steer the boat a bit. Unlimited drinks and snacks made it perfect. 
Highly recommended.
